checks.check: Every row (invoices and credit memos) is dated inside the chosen dates
Totals row: Inv. Hrs, hours worked, Labor Invoiced, Parts Invoiced, Parts Cost, Profit, Subtotal = sum of the rows
Totals row percentages are recalculated from the totals (Billing Efficiency, Labor Margin, Parts Margin, Margin)
Inv. Hrs = billed hours on the work order (Stats tab estimated hours)
Hours worked behind Billing Efficiency = clocked hours on the work order (Stats tab)
checks.source: SV-2463 "It needs to match the statistics tab"

checks.check: Billing Efficiency = Inv. Hrs / hours clocked x 100; N/A when nothing clocked
Labor Invoiced = labor sell on the Stats tab
Labor cost behind Labor Margin = labor cost on the Stats tab
Labor Margin = (Labor Invoiced - labor cost) / Labor Invoiced x 100
Parts Invoiced = parts sell on the Stats tab
Parts Cost = parts cost on the work order Stats tab
Parts Margin = (Parts Invoiced - Parts Cost) / Parts Invoiced x 100
Profit = (Labor Invoiced - labor cost) + (Parts Invoiced - Parts Cost)
checks.source: SV-2107 Total Margin Row (total sell - total cost)

checks.check: Profit = total margin on the work order Stats tab
Margin = Profit / (Labor Invoiced + Parts Invoiced) x 100
Work order with no lines on its Stats tab shows 0 in every column
Credit memo row: Parts Invoiced and Subtotal are negative
Credit memo row: Profit = Parts Invoiced - Parts Cost (a credit reverses the original profit or loss)
Credit memo row: no hours, no labor
Credit memo row shows the credit number and no work-order link
Credit memo row: Parts Margin sign follows the profit (negative when the credit takes profit away)
